name: cozybox
description: CozyBox by Fossey's Distillery — website (Online Shop, Table Booking, Plate Pass) backed by Square APIs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
